title: Bulk BCR repertoire analysis
description: Code used to process (pRESTO, IgBLAST, Change-O) and analyse (gene usage, SHM, CDR3, clonality) bulk UMI-based B cell receptor repertoire sequencing of 272 libraries (IgG, IgM, Igκ, Igλ; two technical replicates) from 34 FRESH cohort participants. Includes primer sequences.
